title: Left or right
starting_code:
# Look at the attribute `locked` to see whether the left door is locked.

# If it is, walk to the right door, open it with `open`, go through and along the corridor.

# Else do the same by the left door.
hints: We can look at the left door's attribute `locked`!
If the left is locked, walk 2 down and 3 right to `right_door`, open it, walk 3 down and 3 right to the mark.
If it is not, `else:`, walk 2 down, 3 left to `left_door`, open it, walk 3 down and 9 right!
intro: Look, a room with two doors! One of them is locked tonight, and there are no keys anywhere. But we can look at the attribute `locked` of the left door, `left_door.locked`! If it is locked, we will go through the right door, and if not, through the left one. The mark waits for us in the corridor, to the right!
outro: We are on the other side! I think these doors change every night, and I have a program for when we come back that does not work at all...
learned: Now you know that `if` and `else` can look at an attribute, like `locked`, and choose the way by it.
changes: The door that is locked changes each time.
